about: Real conversations from the owner's phone tests, asked to the real AI before every server update (tests/real_ai_check.py). Each check is about the words of the answer, goal and plan together, in lower case. all: every group must have at least one of its words. none: none of these may appear. kind: guide or answer, when it matters. Add a case for every chat that went wrong.
